title: Worked Great 5 times and then stopped
text:
Worked Great 5 times and then stopped. The attached picture shows the problem after working successfully 5 times. The temperature now registers 186 degrees and the prong is just sitting at room temperature! This makes the device unusable.

Please don't buy this item. The display is also very dim, making it hard to read.

But like I said, it was good while it lasted. Can anyone recommend something quality that won't break?
